fonte.edicao: A Dictionary of the Targumim, the Talmud Babli and Yerushalmi, and the Midrashic Literature
fonte.texto_fonte: אאלר"ן , a fictitious word made up of each third letter in מנא̇ מנא̇ תקל̇ ופר̇סין̇ (Dan. V, 25). Snh. 22ᵃ; Cant. R. to III, 4 ממתו"ס וכ׳ the inscription on the wall was so arranged as to form words composed of its every first, every second and every third letter respectively.

conferencia.observacoes:

[CONSULTA REALIZADA — Sefaria] Texto conferido em 2026-10-14. Lemma, gloss, refs. (Dan. V 25; Snh. 22ᵃ; Cant. R. III 4) e a nota sobre as marcas gráficas conferem integralmente. Nenhuma variante de cabeçalho registrada na fonte.

[PENDENTE] Confirmar vol./pág. no fac-símile (archive.org). Sefaria não exibe paginação da ed. 1903.
